name: ShopSavvy
description: Product lookup by name, barcode, ASIN or URL, current prices across tens of thousands of retailers, price history and buying guides for 30M+ products, via ShopSavvy's hosted MCP endpoint. Works without signup; add a Data API key for higher limits.

inputs.label: ShopSavvy Data API Key
inputs.description: Optional. Anonymous access works (10 tool calls a minute per IP); a ShopSavvy Data API key raises the limit and enables scheduled price monitoring.

obtain.instructions:
1. Open shopsavvy.com/data
2. Choose a plan and create your account
3. Copy your API key (starts with ss_live_)

auth.instructions: Works without a key (rate-limited per IP). Add a ShopSavvy Data API key via the Authorization: Bearer header for higher limits. Get one at shopsavvy.com/data.
